`class BooleanSignal`<br/>
**Extends:** [`Signal<Boolean>`](/reference/signals/signal/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.signal.impl.primitive` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [BooleanSignal.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/signal/impl/primitive/BooleanSignal.java)

Signal of a `boolean`, for a state that is on or off.

## Description

It works like [`Signal`](/reference/signals/signal/) and adds `toggle()`.

## Creation details

<a id="BooleanSignal-constructor"></a>

### BooleanSignal

`BooleanSignal()` 

Creates a signal whose value and default value are `false`.

`BooleanSignal(boolean value)` 

Creates a signal whose value and default value are `value`.

## Method details

<a id="BooleanSignal-method-toggle"></a>

### toggle

`this toggle()` <span class="joid-qualifier">fluent</span>

Inverts the value, then returns this signal.
Called from another thread, it inverts the value that the signal holds when the write applies on the render thread.
